stem.text: A vertically polarised electromagnetic wave of intensity $I_0$ is incident normally on a polarising filter. The transmission axis of the filter is at an angle of $30^{\circ}$ to the vertical.
The transmitted wave from the first filter is then incident normally on a second polarising filter. The transmission axis of this filter is at an angle of $90^{\circ}$ to the vertical.

stem.alt: Diagram of two polarising filters drawn as grey rectangles on a straight line representing the incident wave, with the outgoing wave continuing to the right. Labels: transmission axis (two), 30°, polarising filters, and vertically polarised electromagnetic wave. Dashed lines show the vertical and the transmission axes of the filters.

stem.text: What is the intensity of the wave after passing through the second filter?
